extraction.notes: Three months ended 9/30/2025 column from the FFO/Core FFO reconciliation (page S-8). Subtotals verified: 53,783 + adjustments = 23,347 FFO; 23,347 + adjustments = 23,360 Core FFO. Diluted shares 19,771K reproduces reported per-share figures: FFO diluted 23,456/19,771 = $1.19 and Core FFO diluted 23,469/19,771 = $1.19. Company has no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Category judgments: 'Interest rate swap amortization' mapped to debt_cost_amortization; 'Other miscellaneous items (2)' (gain/loss on investments and one-time professional fees) mapped to 'other' since it mixes investment gains and professional fees; 'Redemption of preferred shares' is a zero (dash) in this quarter and mapped to 'other'. recurring_capex_disclosed: the company does not subtract recurring capex in any AFFO, so I took the only current-quarter disclosure from the portfolio summary (S-15): Same-Store total recurring capital expenditures of $350 per apartment home. This is a per-unit dollar figure, not a total in thousands, so it is recorded as per_unit_only and should not be used as a dollar total.
